description: React component for creating a new integration via a modal dialog, including form management, API interactions for fetching connectors and creating integrations, and UI rendering for multi-step process.

methods.name: loadConnectedServices
methods.description: Fetches connectors from API or uses mock data for development; filters connected services.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances the step in the multi-step form.

methods.name: handlePrevious
methods.description: Returns to the previous step in the multi-step form.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the form data to create a new integration via API.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets form data to initial state.

methods.name: getConnectorIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon for a connector based on its ID.
